searchText: I am reviewing rpc combat tests https://hive.ethpandaops.io/#/test/generic/1758596210-fdde7f4f76a8c6e76c567698d9d4bde5?testnumber=28, and I have questions/suggestions. Test: eth_estimateGas/estimate-successful-call Should we assume that clients return the same value in estimates, or is the test checking something else? As long as tx can be executed, it should be fine. The exact value for eth transfers makes sense, though Test: eth_feeHistory/fee-history Can we add some precisions here? For context, please check the screen I think we can remove the estimate call test, or change the verification of it since i don't expect all clients to return the same estimate value for the fee history, adding some precision seems fine to me Same, but estimate gas for Eth transfers it makes sense though ( eth_estimateGas/estimate-simple-transfer), we will fix it in NMC <@543900561460822016> If we have estimateGas, we should test whether it was sufficient to execute the transaction without reverting. Those tests would be very useful, but checking the exact gas number doesn’t make sense. <@543900561460822016> qq about eth_getLogs, tests complain that Nethermind doesn't return "blockTimestamp". I am wondering if we should add this field (probably yes). Have you been asked by users for this? I see that Geth, Reth returns it while Nethermind, Besu not This has been a long requested feature: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/295 Thx, we will add it then! 🙂

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
I am reviewing rpc combat tests https://hive.ethpandaops.io/#/test/generic/1758596210-fdde7f4f76a8c6e76c567698d9d4bde5?testnumber=28, and I have questions/suggestions.

 Test: eth_estimateGas/estimate-successful-call 

Should we assume that clients return the same value in estimates, or is the test checking something else? As long as tx can be executed, it should be fine. The exact value for eth transfers makes sense, though

Test: eth_feeHistory/fee-history 
Can we add some precisions here? For context, please check the screen

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: I think we can remove the estimate call test, or change the verification of it since i don't expect all clients to return the same estimate value

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: for the fee history, adding some precision seems fine to me

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
Same, but estimate gas for Eth transfers it makes sense though (
eth_estimateGas/estimate-simple-transfer), we will fix it in NMC

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content: <@543900561460822016> If we have estimateGas, we should test whether it was sufficient to execute the transaction without reverting. Those tests would be very useful, but checking the exact gas number doesn’t make sense.

excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content: <@543900561460822016> qq about eth_getLogs, tests complain that Nethermind doesn't return "blockTimestamp". I am wondering if we should add this field (probably yes). Have you been asked by users for this? I see that Geth, Reth returns it while Nethermind, Besu not
